attestations.text: MO Yu-chih 莫友芝 (T. 子偲, H. 郘亭, 眲叟), 1811–1871, Oct. 27, scholar and bibliophile, was a native of Tu-shan, Kweichow. His father, Mo Yü-ch'ou 莫與儔 (T. 猶人, 傑夫, H. 1763–1841), was a chin-shih of 1799 and for many years after 1808 he served as prefectural director of schools in Tsun-i, Kweichow.
